title: Deactivated account cannot log in
actual: This account is deactivated. Contact the coordinator.

title: Role-based redirect after login
action: Login as coordinator, volunteer1 and donor1
expected: Staff land on the dashboard, the donor on My Donations

title: Record a donation with quantity 0 (BR-01)
action: Volunteer submits Record Donation with quantity 0
expected: Rejected with 'Quantity must be greater than 0'; no row saved
actual: Quantity must be greater than 0  (rows before/after: 16/16)

title: Future donation date (BR-05)
action: Record donation dated 3 days from today
expected: Rejected: date cannot be in the future; no row saved
actual: Donation date cannot be in the future.

title: Inactive donor (BR-02)
action: Record donation for inactive donor #9 (Pedro Villanueva)
expected: Rejected with 'Donor/Category is inactive'; nothing saved

title: Inactive category (BR-02)
action: Record donation in inactive category #7 (Medical Supplies)
expected: Rejected with 'Donor/Category is inactive'; nothing saved

title: Record a valid donation (Create)
action: Volunteer records 75.5 kg of rice from Juan dela Cruz
expected: Saved with status RECORDED and recorded_by = volunteer1 (user 2)

title: Filter by category and date range
action: Open Donations with category_id=2, from=2026-11-01, to=2026-11-30

title: Pagination
action: Open Donations page 1 and page 2 (8 per page, 17 rows)
expected: Page 1 has 8 rows and page 2 has 8 rows

title: SQL injection attempt in search box
expected: Treated as plain text: no rows, no database error
actual: HTTP 200, message: 'No donations match your filters.'

title: Distribute more than the remaining quantity (BR-04)
action: Distribute 100 kg from donation #17 (75.5 kg available)
expected: Rejected; remaining quantity and status unchanged
actual:
Quantity exceeds the remaining amount (75.5 left). Nothing was saved.
   before (status, remaining): VERIFIED	75.50 | after: VERIFIED	75.50

title: Distribute a negative quantity (BR-01)
expected: Rejected with 'Quantity must be greater than 0'

title: Distribution date earlier than donation date (BR-05)
expected: Rejected with a date validation message
actual: Distribution date cannot be earlier than the donation date (2026-11-19).

title: Partial distribution
expected: Distribution row saved; status VERIFIED -> PARTIAL; remaining 45.50

title: Invalid status change (BR-03)
action: Try to verify donation #17 which is already DISTRIBUTED
actual: Invalid status change: DISTRIBUTED cannot become VERIFIED. (status = DISTRIBUTED)

title: Cancel requires a reason
action: Cancel donation #11 with an empty reason

title: Cancel a RECORDED donation with a reason
expected: Status RECORDED -> CANCELLED with the reason saved

title: A PARTIAL donation cannot be cancelled (BR-03)
actual: Invalid status change: PARTIAL cannot become CANCELLED.

title: Delete a donor that has donations (BR-06)
expected: Refused by the foreign key; message offers Cancel/Deactivate; donor still exists
actual: This record is used by other records and cannot be deleted. Cancel or deactivate it instead. (donor rows: 1)

title: Delete a second donor that has a donation (BR-06)
action: Delete donor #8 (Harmony Students Org, has donation #8)
expected: Refused by foreign key; donor remains
actual: This record is used by other records and cannot be deleted. Cancel or deactivate it instead.

title: Delete a donor with no donations
Delete a donation that has distributions
expected: Refused (application check; the FOREIGN KEY also blocks it, see TC-56); donation remains
actual: Only RECORDED donations can be deleted. Cancel this donation instead.

title: Duplicate donor email is rejected
action: Add two donors with email dup@example.com
expected: Second save rejected: 'A donor with this email already exists.' (MySQL error 1062)
actual: A donor with this email already exists.

title: Donor form validation
action: Submit empty name and invalid email
actual: Donor name is required. Enter a valid email address.

title: Edit a donor (Update)
action: Rename Test Donor A and change type to BUSINESS

title: Duplicate category name is rejected
expected: Rejected: 'A category with this name already exists.'
actual: A category with this name already exists.

title: Delete a category that has donations (BR-06)
expected: Refused by foreign key; category remains
actual: This record is used by other records and cannot be deleted. Cancel or deactivate it instead.

title: User form rejects a short password
actual: Password must be at least 8 characters.

title: Create a user; password stored hashed
expected: Row inserted; password_hash is a bcrypt hash, not plain text

title: Category totals report
expected: Received/Distributed/Remaining agree with a direct SQL query
actual: Canned Goods on page = ['446', '210', '236']; SQL = Canned Goods | 446.00 | 210.00

title: Report rejects an invalid date range
actual: The "from" date cannot be later than the "to" date.

title: Volunteer cannot verify a donation (BR-08)
action: Volunteer POSTs verify for RECORDED donation #15

title: Volunteer cannot distribute (BR-08)
action: Volunteer POSTs distribute for VERIFIED donation #14

title: Volunteer cannot cancel a donation (BR-08)
action: Volunteer POSTs cancel for VERIFIED donation #6

title: Volunteer cannot edit another volunteer's donation (BR-08)
action: volunteer1 opens the edit form of donation #15 (recorded by volunteer2)

title: Donor cannot open the staff donation list (BR-08)
Donor sees only their own donations (FR-11)
expected: Only donations of donor Maria Santos: 12,2

title: Anonymous visitor is sent to login
Form without CSRF token is refused
action: POST cancel without the hidden csrf field

title: Output escaping (XSS)
action: Save a donor named <script>alert(1)</script> and view the list

title: Database CHECK constraint on quantity (BR-01)
action: INSERT a donation with quantity 0 directly in MySQL
actual: ERROR 4025 (23000) at line 1: CONSTRAINT `chk_donations_qty` failed for `donatetrack`.`donations`

title: Foreign key rejects an unknown donor
actual: ERROR 1452 (23000) at line 1: Cannot add or update a child row: a foreign key constraint fails (`donatetrack`.`donations`, CONSTRAINT `fk_donations_donor` FOREIGN KEY (`donor_id`) REFERENCES `donors` (`donor_id`) ON UPDATE CASCADE)

title: Application account cannot write the audit table (BR-07)
actual: ERROR 1142 (42000) at line 1: INSERT command denied to user 'donatetrack_app'@'localhost' for table `donatetrack`.`distribution_audit`

title: Application account can read working tables
action: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM donations as donatetrack_app

title: Foreign key RESTRICT blocks deleting a donation that has distributions (BR-06)
actual: ERROR 1451 (23000) at line 1: Cannot delete or update a parent row: a foreign key constraint fails (`donatetrack`.`distributions`, CONSTRAINT `fk_distributions_donation` FOREIGN KEY (`donation_id`) REFERENCES `donations` (`donation_id`) ON UPDATE CASCADE)

title: Backup and restore (mysqldump)
action: mysqldump the database, import into a fresh database, compare row counts
expected: Row counts (donations, distributions, donors) are identical
